input.question: What is the population of Bennington Township?

documents.text: the census [ 1 ] of 2010 , there were 3,168 people , 1,252 households , and 906 families residing in the township . The population density was 82.7 inhabitants per square mile ( 31.9/km 2 ) . There were 1,252 housing units at an average density of 30.4 per square mile ( 11.7/km 2 ) . The racial makeup of the township was 97.58 % White , 0.17 % African American , 0.30 % Native American , 0.46 % Asian , 0.53 % from other races , and 0.96 % from two or more races .
